reports.desc: Found the job posting on Indeed. It seemed legitimate at first and had contact with the company in phone calls and emails and through there online portal. Inspecting packages and re-shipping them. Until the police showed up and confiscated a package saying it was bought with a stolen credit card. I contacted the company immediately to inform them and surrendered the package to the police department. After that i tried to reach back out to the company regarding the other packages i had to ship out and how to proceed but cannot get in contact with them or log into my portal through them. They had me do an interview and fill out tax documents as well.

I filled out return of goods form and send within 90 days.  I sent packages back on 9/3/2026 by USPS with signature required. And tracker stated packages were received on 9/8/2026. I contacted Harold Customer Support by email with tracking number. 9/10/2026 Harold said he received tracking number and was going to search f I r thw packages. No response as of 9/18/2026.No updates and no refund for Package #******

I signed up for a low cost trial for $10 and then paid for additional services for $29 to help with my resume. However, I canceled the subscription service and never thought anything of it. I recently noticed a $75 charge on my account on Sept. 15, 2026 and contacted them because this should have been canceled months ago.
I reviewed my account and they had been charging me $75/month since March.
I requested a refund for $300 of the $375 but they kept saying they would only provide a 50% refund for the Sept charge which is ridiculous. I even offered $300 in case I canceled after the trial period, but I definitely canceled months ago because the service was no good!
As another person stated, it is just an automated AI response which is attached, regardless of my request for a proper refund. Nothing but a scam.

We are confident in our natural formulas, which is why every purchase is backed by our 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee. If you are not completely satisfied with your results, simply contact our support team within 30 days for a full refund.
Has this on the website but they will not honor it. I contacted them 3 times n was blown off

The scammer billed the amount of $13,725 to Medicare using my Medicare number. My Medicare Summary Notice indicated that none of the fraudulent claims were approved and therefore nothing paid out by Medicare. Claims were for 1500 intermittent urinary catheters ordered by a Daniel J Kruse (scammer).

I recieved an error message when attempting to enter my credit card information.
I have had conversations with customer service over the past few days attempting to resolve this issue.
The representatives always want to take the order over the phone. This method of ordering is extremely time consuming and costly. It seems like a scam.
The representative wants me to believe that if I enter my credit card number on my phone keypad, that the information is somehow protected.
Having worked in Information Systems I understand CRC (cyclical redundancy checking) and a whole lot more. Your assurances that everything is kosher falls on deaf ears.
The whole thing seems like a scam to me.

Multiple calls from multiple phone numbers that have my name on file (which is PPI). I've asked multiple times to be removed from their calling list. They seem to be a new extension of United Covenant Financial, another scam group that calls people with phony loan offers. Every time I ask a representative to remove me from the list, they get dismissive, talk over me, and eventually hang up on me. I've blocked every number they've called me from and I don't know what to do anymore.

I bought a safety tool to break car windows or cut a seatbelt in an emergency. I ordered them for myself and my family for peace of mind. The product is bogus and I fear someone could die for believing the claims made. Thank you! The photos show the advertisement and the actual product, which claims to have a tungsten tip to break glass, it does not! Also is a list of materials used, tungsten is not on it! Thank you.
Joy hardester  social security  bank information

Solbrace advertises returns but I’ve emailed them 4 times to initiate a return and never received a response.  Their website says they’ll respond to return requests in 2 business days.  My first email was sent 3 weeks ago and still no response.

Voicemail said "This is (garbled) with processing department. Our office has received preliminary paperwork and this phone number was listed as a possible contact number for the individual we're attempting to obtain updated location information for. Please return our call at your earliest convenience so we can stop any further skip tracing efforts and work toward an amicable resolution over the next few days. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to speaking with you.

This company is advertising tickets for The Legacy Theater in Carthage, Illinois at a 50% increased price than what we sell them for.  They are offering parking packages, which we do not offer.  They are doing this without our authorization to do so.  We want to have them cease and desist offering tickets to our theater.
The form received was CF1003 requesting a corporate filing fee of $136.22.
Fake plastic teeth that were supposed to be silicone dentures no way to get a refund. Can't find anything but email. No response from it
